experience.title: Embedded Firmware Intern
bullets: Added a 200 ms soft-start ramp to the STM32 PWM firmware for a 24 V brushless drive, which lowered startup current spikes by 35% across 50 starts measured with a current probe
Cut bring-up from 2 days to 4 hours with a Python script that tests 40 channels over UART
Fixed a CAN bus bug that dropped 1 message in 200 by measuring bit timing on an oscilloscope and moving the sample point to 87.5%, then ran a 12-hour soak test with no dropped messages

experience.title: Test Engineering Intern
bullets: Automated a 20-point load sweep in LabVIEW with a programmable load and a power analyzer, so an efficiency test on the 500 W supply took 25 minutes instead of the 3 hours it took by hand
Found a 15 °C hot spot that the derating curve missed on a 12 V module by logging 8 thermocouples through a 48-hour full-load test, and the design team enlarged the heatsink on the next revision

projects.title: Senior Design: Solar Charge Controller
bullets: Wrote perturb-and-observe MPPT firmware in C for an STM32 that updates every 10 ms and harvested 18% more energy than a fixed-voltage controller in tests on a solar array simulator
Laid out a 100 W buck stage on a 2-layer KiCad board that stays under 70 °C at full load
Sized the output filter in LTspice and measured 42 mV of ripple on the oscilloscope

projects.title: Digital Audio Filter on an FPGA
bullets: Built a 32-tap FIR low-pass filter in Verilog on a Basys 3 board running at 48 kHz, with 16-bit fixed-point coefficients that matched the MATLAB design within 0.3 dB in Vivado simulation
